title: Afterimage
description: A mosaic of small tiles trades a relief print for its inverse.
useCase: Transition between paired artworks or campaign states with a brief discontinuous reveal.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Full-bleed flat vermilion print with thick charcoal curved stripes sweeping into a band, a yellow circle with crosshair, and a round refresh button.
motion: Clicking the print swaps it for a rotated cobalt-and-amber inverse under a 10×8 grid of cream tiles that blink off in scattered order over roughly 0.3 s.
adapt: The reveal is the `tiles` grid (80 cells re-keyed by `run`), each running `sf-mosaic-tile` (0.24 s, `steps(1,end)`) after a scattered `animationDelay`; tune grid size, delay spread and tile colour. Replace the two SVG prints inside `relief`.
